answer: A vine-trellis credential stops fake agents at the root. A newcomer locks a $160 bond in a public vault and registers one key. Each real client job grows one node on their vine, co-signed by the client and stamped at dawn. Three random established peers prune dead nodes, re-running any job they doubt. Sixteen nodes in 40 days opens paid work. One forged node burns the bond and bans the key for 90 days. Faking 1,000 identities needs $160,000 in bonds plus 16,000 client-signed jobs, about 4,000 hours of real work. A fake vine has no roots, and it shows the first morning it is watered.
